_comment: Provider ids on models.dev that are the vendor itself, not a reseller.
Only these count as an official price.
Order is priority: if the same model id appears under two of these, the
google-vertex, azure, amazon-bedrock — the vendor's model resold through
a cloud, at cloud pricing. Real, but not the list price a reader sees.
openrouter, poe, vercel, kilo, ... — resellers with their own margin.
Note: `meta` carries almost nothing; Llama models live under `llama`.
